memory_candidates.content: In this agent system, when Stage 5 of /orchestrate needs a fallback outcome signal for dispatches that never write .orchestrator-handoff.json (base-mode research/plan/implement), the established pattern (per command-gate-out.sh's precedent) is to read .return-meta.json's own status field rather than inventing a new writing obligation for those skills. A single shared script (orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh) normalizes the file into the same outcome fields the handoff-present path already produces, consulted identically by base Stage 5, hard-mode Stage 5, and multi-task Stage MT-4 — mirroring the existing orchestrate-triage-classify.sh / skill_gate_completion_claim discipline of putting a cross-site rule in exactly one executable place.

When markdown SKILL.md files embed fenced bash blocks inside numbered list items, the closing ``` fence is indented with the list's leading whitespace (e.g. three spaces before the backticks) rather than starting at column 0. A naive regex extraction for bash -n verification (like r'```bash
(.*?)
```') will silently fail to match these indented-fence blocks and undercount them; the fix is to allow leading whitespace before the closing fence (r'```bash
(.*?)
[ 	]*```') and dedent the captured body before parsing.
